meta.purpose: Curated starting points for the Route Explorer multi-country journey builder. These are planning presets, not fixed packages or live itineraries.

presets.title: Desert to Delta
presets.summary: Connect Namibia's desert circuit with Botswana's Okavango and Chobe wildlife route.

presets.title: Cape to Indian Ocean
presets.summary: Pair South Africa's southern coast with Mozambique's lagoons and beaches.

presets.title: Falls and Northern Safari
presets.summary: Build a connected Zambia, Zimbabwe and Botswana journey around the Zambezi and major wildlife areas.

presets.title: Mountain Kingdoms Circuit
presets.summary: Link Lesotho and Eswatini through a practical South Africa connection.

presets.title: Lake and Indian Ocean
presets.summary: Combine Malawi's lake and highlands with a researched Mozambique route.

presets.title: Grand Southern Safari
presets.summary: Join South Africa, Botswana and Namibia into one 30-day wildlife and landscapes journey.
